rules.rule: A trait impl for a foreign type (i.e. not defined in our crate; like: `impl SomeTrait for Vec<T>`), must live in an `ext_traits` commons module (see import-rules check).
All other impls must live in a 't' commons module (see import-rules check), and must be in the same file or a sibling file of the type's definition.

impl-location-check.exemption: For private types, an impl lives in the same file as the type definition, which can be anywhere in the codebase.
